scope: Non-admin Store reviewer acceptance harness target sequencing; no product answer verdict
cause: The original member helper closed the demo and foregrounded the unrelated root fixture. The first repair retained the demo but still called a native opener whose trusted click came from the root fixture; switching to the demo after that reopen left the panel hidden in the first native rerun.
changed: The foreground helper keeps the demo tab open, activates it before native reopening, and passes it as the opener trigger page.

The native opener installs its canonical trusted FRONTEND_RPC button on the owned demo document and clicks it there when the panel is hidden. The default root-fixture path used by other acceptance flows is retained.
Both member Chat sends now check the active current-window tab URL and a unique marker on the intended demo document before the send callback runs.
A target mismatch records reviewer_chat_target_unverified and prevents a model request; the existing final cleanup still closes the web tab.

verification.original_red: Before the source fix, node --test --test-name-pattern='member foreground retains' tests/browser/reviewer-chat-foreground-restoration.test.mjs failed because the old helper closed the demo and foregrounded root before panel reopen.
verification.mutation: A local bypass mutant that disabled both target comparisons failed member-chat-target.test.mjs with Missing expected rejection; it would have sent on the research brief.
verification.static_checks: Biome check on all six second-round source/test files passed; the first-round reviewer runner also passed node --check.
verification.first_native_rerun: Exact Store 0.2.557 non-admin run 39295371484 failed before any Chat send: panel_reopen and demo_foreground completed, then visibility_wait timed out after about 10.4 seconds. All four recorded native visibility phases were hidden; exact panel target remained present and web remained open. No assigned-tab guard or product answer was exercised.
verification.second_round_red: The new dynamic native-opener test failed against the 17a6c00a7 source: its panel remained owned by root while the expected active demo assertion saw root.
verification.second_round_green: 21 focused tests passed, including dynamic panel visibility tied to active tab/owner, canonical demo opener wiring, surrounding hidden/visible panel cases, foreground diagnostics, and wrong-target Chat refusal.

sibling_census.foreground_helper_callers: One runner call in reviewer-chat-store-acceptance.mjs, plus its direct unit tests; no other production acceptance caller uses restoreMemberForeground or restoreMemberForegroundWithReport.
sibling_census.native_opener: activateOwnedSidePanel now accepts an intended trigger page. Existing root callers keep the root fixture; the member caller supplies the demo. Its trusted sender is the demo when reopening is needed.
sibling_census.chat_sends: Both opening and same-conversation follow-up sends use the same target guard.

open_questions: A fresh native non-admin acceptance run must confirm that the demo-triggered opener makes the exact panel visible, the intended demo passes both send guards, and the actual answer meets the page task. No product answer verdict is established by either source repair.
